I went into the store today to get a fill up and take them up on the free 2 l Coca-Cola product with any gasoline fill up offer. Which is a very good deal and has made me come to this location over other gas stations that are cheaper within old saybrook. I have never had a negative interaction with anyone here previously but the gentleman working when I gave him my money said he didn't have enough to break it for $3, so I walked out when I turned around to ask him did you hear that I said $30 and not three he said "oh, no I thought you said $3." I then asked if he had money to break my larger bill if I was getting $30 in gas. He said yes, so I thought that worked out. He then asked me if I was okay, I said yes I just was surprised at 3:47 in the afternoon when you open up at 6:00 a.m. you wouldn't have changed for a larger bill. When I was getting $30 in gas. He said well just seems like when you come in here you have an attitude not just this time. I found that odd because really I had not dealt with him too much in the store previously, I said well I didn't mean to have an attitude and he replied back that I did. Must be nice to be able to tell your customers that they have an attitude, I did not say anything to him I was just walking out of the store when he said he couldn't break my bill when I was filling up my tank. After this interaction however I told him and will state here I will never come back to this gas station. There is one that is closer to my house and about the same price and another that is a little bit further from my house but the cheapest in the area. so I will either go to the cheaper one or the one that's closer and not go to this location where I was happy with the free 2 l soda and that was the main draw. However now dealing with that for customer service I can say I will never be back here. Henny Penny get your employees in line and if that was a manager this Henny Penny location definitely needs help. A business that has the tagline of "fast. Fresh. Family owned." should definitely be nicer and more accommodating then today's final experience was for me. I know that this is one review from one customer and to a business that probably is not that important, but for this customer I will definitely be taking my business elsewhere.

Everything started off good. Joey was our sales rep. I should of known when he asked me if I could make Decisions or if my husband needed to be home was an indication. He gave us a quote, little higher than others- but was going on this was the best quality out there with best customer service. We ordered 23 windows. My husband came home during the meeting and was concerned about the plantation shutters we had put in- Joey assured us numerous times they would be fine. We had a big discussion over the back door in the playroom (again with matching shutters.) To make a long story short... the shutters did not fit the door. We did not want to spend another $900 on shutters just for the door... and have an mismatching issue.- this is why we astressed this issue. The door did not work- Joey said we never talked about it and still needed to pay for it. We ordered 23 large windows, spent thousands of dollars and he is arguing over a door. It could of easy been resolved if he did not start out the conversation with ,”We never discussed this.” The product is fine- there are better ones out there and we did overpay looking back. The best part of this experience was the hard working installers. Nick and his crew were amazing, hardworking, on time and just good people. He went above and beyond on everything- just sad Joey could not follow up and do the same with customer service. The end result was we ended up paying for the door. He gave us a minimal credit, and a bunch of BS. Make sure you get everything itemized. We asked several times and he would not give us an itemized statement - just a price.. We wanted to know how much each window was and what we were paying for. We never received any individual cost, which makes it easy when it comes to a “discount” on the door that did not work. The “discount” was not the retail amount they charged us in everything else- appears to be the cost so Joey would not have it come out of his commission. My advice is to keep everything simple and written out, so you know exactly what you are paying for. Joey’s best friend is the owner- so talking to management was a waste. Please buy LOCAL, it’s easier to maintain honest, customer service. We made a big mistake.

Enter at your own risk.... So let's get the easy stuff outta the way- the staff was friendly. Now that that's done, let's gets down to business. Don't stay here. Let's begin with the parking lot. A lady with quite a few teeth missing propositioned me. Sure I may be dashing and handsome, but that doesn't mean one should conduct themselves like that. It's unbecoming a lady. Next, the elevator. It worked. I didn't die. That's always a plus. Pretty sure it was hydraulic which means the stairs are faster. And now, my room. It's smells like gas, or oil. Maybe the engine compartment of my dad's 72 Chevy. If you enjoy walking on low pile carpet with absolutely no padding, you'll love the rooms here. Would you like a bed with no box spring and just a metal frame with springs? Gotcha covered. You know how freshly laundered sheets feel crisp? Well don't worry about that here. They feel nice and broken in, just waiting for you to jump in. ( Now you know why I bring my own hostel sheet and blanket ) Do you like listening to others people's dogs bark all afternoon and into the night? You're in luck, the place is full of them. How about rooms that claim to be non smoking, yet you can clearly smell incense burning, which we all know is used to mask the odor of other combustible items.. check that box! There's a full kitchen, that's right. But alas, there are no utensils, plates, cups, pots, pans, glasses or knives. Wanna know how to obtain such things? Pay $30 and it's yours. Oh, no coffee maker, iron or blow dryer. But there are towels. No additional fee here. For now. Don't think about blowing your nose. You won't find tissues around here. Just some super awesome, single ply toilet paper guaranteed to irritate your nose. The fridge had a hard time staying cold, know why? Because the door open sensor is going out and the light stays on all the time. I know because the seal around the door was off and I can see the light creeping through. I should just leave my GatorAde on the counter next time. Far cooler than a box with an 80 watt light a foot away. The desk chairs are straight out of a corporate break room. No cushion, just lovely hard plastic. I don't watch TV, so I have no idea if it worked or the channels it contained. There was a remote, but no guide to be found. The AC unit made sound, which was great as that helped to drown out the barking dogs. But did it keep the room cold? Sorta. Well, it was better than sleeping outside on the hood of my car. So, Mr. Whiny Reviewer, why did you stay here? Second chances. I stayed at the same chain in Beaumont and had a bad experience. So I thought that maybe the hotel sucked because Beaumont sucks. Nope. It's a chain thing. I was hoping it to be an isolated incident. But alas, I was wrong. It's just sad that for an additional $20, you could stay at a Marriott variant of the same hotel style and get a totally enjoyable experience. With breakfast and dinner that includes free beer and wine! And a lobby that doesn't feel like the Salle Port in a jail. Oh, and a kitchen with stuff in it. The kind of stuff that will allow you to cook your own food. No additional fee. TL:DR version 1/10, will not stay again. And don't bother to post the carbon copy 'thanks for the feedback, let us try to earn your business' line, Mr Woodspring Hotel. Anyone reading these reviews can see there are better options out there. Like sleeping in a rest stop off 45 North with your windows rolled down and your wallet taped to your forehead. I hope you enjoyed this review more than I enjoyed staying here. Later.

I didn't end up eating here, went a few blocks down the street instead. Want to know why? Yes, its about those pesky masks.... read on So some background: apparently the city of Pensacola, has a mask mandate, which I was not aware of, as on Pensacola Beach for example this is not a thing. Of course it cannot be enforced by any law enforcement, because of the Governor's order. But the rule exist within Pensacola city limits enacted by the mayor (a Republican - as if there is any difference), who apparently has authority under Sec. 2-4-8 of the Pensacola City Ordinance to do whatever he wants. It is valid for 30 days under the section. But not to worry everyone!!! The city council can extend it anytime, and of course the emergency order can be renewed indefinitely 30 days at a time, as long as there is a state of emergency in the county, or Florida or U.S. And of course the great Governor DeSantis keeps extending the state of emergency in the state, so really this is going to probably be a perpetual order. In fact, a mayor can declare an emergency anytime and suspend all current law anytime for any amount of time. And why not. I mean who doesn't think the government should have the power to do whatever they want just by proclaiming that "its an emergency". I am sure our elected leaders have a good time at their cocktail parties, laughing "maskless", at us peons. Now to the restaurant. When you come in, you are required put on a face diaper, in order to be walked to the table. Then when you sit down, you can of course, take off your face diaper, breathe in, breathe out, talk, eat, because at the table COVID doesn't spread. But if you must go to the bathroom, you must get that face diaper back on, which of course you touched with your dirty hands, and was put on a table which was probably spit and sneezed on by 20 people that day or just a person who passed by 5 min before you sat down. Because I think, walking, is when COVID really gets you. Or maybe its the time, when a perfectly healthy person starts spreading COVID, all while walking. I really don't know, as I get these things confused with this new Covidian religion. Well, at least we can be comforted that the restaurant is open for business, and can still charge $60 for a New York Stip, am I right? So when I first came in, and was told this requirement, and I thought - ok, lets give this a try and have a good time... Place was pretty much empty (i.e. "social distanced") so it seemed overkill, but whatever... First, I was asked if I had a mask (which of course anyone reading this far can gather - I do not even own one). The hostess offered a surgical mask (which as the science tells us does absolutely nothing to block anything, much less a virus), with what seemed like some disdain. So I slapped it on and said "ok, lets go"... but that wasn't enough apparently for the hostess. I was then questioned by the hostess, again with what seemed like disdain, and before I can be taken to the table, as to whether I "will agree to mask up anytime I get up from my table". To be fair, I couldn't really tell if it was disdain, because I couldn't really see her face, as she was wearing a very large black face diaper covering half her face. So maybe she was really smiling underneath, but I had to go on was the tone of voice and eyes sticking out above the large black cloth on her face. So when I asked what's up with this "get up and mask" rule as I'll be taking it off when I sit down anyway, she answered with "do you want to talk to the manager?" - which seemed odd. So I am pretty sure I was spot on about her disdain. It felt like the hostess doesn't think much of us "rubes", who question as to why we need to put on a face diaper to walk from a table to a bathroom for example. In the meantime, standing by the front desk, I watched 2 couples walk out without any masks on. I get it, they were leaving. Of course they don't put on a mask - what's the restaurant going to do - kick them out? Since Google won't let me put more text here, so more fun commentary in the posted picture.

My wife's windshield got a rock chip and set up an appointment with safelight for them to fix it. The safelight representative shows up and gives me the rundown, which included that the windshield was hot and there was a possibility that the chip would expand when they cleaned the windshield. She said that it barely ever happens but if it did that safelight would reimburse my insurance company. What she failed to say was that they would reimburse the $50 for the chip repair but we would pay for the windshield replacement. Of course within 10 seconds of her working on he chip it turned into a 16" scratch in the glass. i thought "no big deal since they broke it they will have to pay for the windshield replacement since that is what she told me". She then explains to me that all they reimburse is the cost of the chip repair, which is obvious because she didn't actually repair the chip, she made it worse and that we would have to pay our $500 insurance deductible to get a new windshield. ARE YOU KIDDING ME?? First of all, if I knew the windshield was that hot and needed to be cooled I would of done that before she came over. She then got very defensive and said that we got an email saying to keep the car in the shade. I took her word for it but it turns out all the email said was to keep the car in the shade "if possible". Regardless it was about 65 degrees outside and the car had been outside for an hour. Secondly, she very clearly made it seem as if safelight would be paying for the windshield replacement if something went wrong, which turned out not to be the case. So basically, Safelight broke my windshield and now I'm out $500 to get a new one.

I also ordered the beer cheese soup to go, which I tasted before I left. I was disappointed that it was spicy. (I'll stick with Granite City's beer cheese soup!) The fried pickles were okay. The French fries were as expected, nothing special. I gave 2 stars instead of 1 because this place does have potential to do better. Clean up waitresses friendliness and attentiveness and make your burgers juicy, as they should be.

Please PLEASE save your time and DO NOT go to this Novant location. I wish there was a zero star option. I took my 4 day old son here that had thrown up blood and home and was continuing to do so in the waiting room. They continued to take patient after patient back (some that appeared to have a broken toe) over my son. After sitting a total of 5 hours in the waiting room and 1 hour in the exam room (and complaining to multiple people) they finally sent a nurse in that pretty much said he didn’t know why it was happening. We left after deciding to go to a different location to get answers. Every staff member that we came in contact with lacked care and compassion. The ER was not even busy, so I would truly hate to see how this hospital functions when they have several emergencies at once. We were told that the only had 1 doctor on staff. Being a first time mom with my baby being only days old, I was distraught. The triage nurse tossed him around like a rag doll only to be treated worse once we got back to the exam room. I have now received a 1800 dollar charge after they did not even touch my son (other than triage taking his temperature and checking him over to obviously put him at the bottom of the list to go back). I am waiting to get an “itemized bill” but according to the billing line, 1800 is the standard charge just for walking in their doors. Please, if you’re from the Lake Norman area, make the extra drive and go to CMC Main or Presbyterian. You will receive so much better care! They sent me a survey in the mail asking about their services. After sending in a negative review, a care member contacted me and promised to get back to me. Of course, I never heard anything other than receiving their bill in the mail. I understand that medical care is expensive. I know how many people probably complain to just get out of paying a bill. I never mind paying to know in my heart that everything is okay with my son. But to be treated in the manner that we were treated, and to have no one at this location care, it is truly heart breaking. I have now learned my lesson and know where to go to get accurate care and customer service.
